notes: Narrator and protagonist. ผม in narration. Polite ครับ to elders and strangers, plain speech to friends. Calls Genjuurou ตา (maternal grandfather). Address terms for the heroines follow the Japanese at that point in the story.

vndb_original: ムラサメ
notes: Sword spirit, looks like a young girl, archaic but cute speech: ข้า / เจ้า, calls Masaomi นายท่าน. No modern polite particles.

notes: Shrine maiden, formal and polite. Calls Masaomi by surname with คุณ until the Japanese switches to his given name.

vndb_original: 常陸 茉子
notes: Ninja attendant, polite modern speech, no archaic particles. Calls Yoshino คุณหนูโยชิโนะ. Calls Masaomi by surname with คุณ until the Japanese switches.

vndb_original: レナ・リヒテナウアー
notes: Foreign exchange student. Her odd であります speech becomes slightly stiff, over-formal Thai with ค่ะ, never ครับ or ขอรับ. Her own grandfather is a different person from Genjuurou.

vndb_original: 馬庭 芦花
notes: Older-sister figure, casual. Calls Masaomi มะบง.

vndb_original: 鞍馬 小春
notes: Rentarou's younger sister, casual and lively. Calls Masaomi พี่ and Genjuurou ปู่ (paternal grandfather).

vndb_original: 鞍馬 廉太郎
notes: Male cousin and friend, casual: ฉัน / แก or นาย, never กู / มึง. Calls Genjuurou ปู่ (paternal grandfather).
